skills.name: Chin's Feathers (鸩羽/鴆の羽)
skills.description: Chin shoots poisonous feathers at a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK and inflicts 2 stacks of Poisonous Feathers on them. ;Poisonous Feathers (毒の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Inflicts a Grade of Poison equal to the number of Poisonous Feathers they have, lasts for 2 turns. Deals indirect damage at the start of turn, then removes 1 stack. Max of 5 stacks.

skills.name: Poisonous Beauty (毒之华/毒の華)
skills.line: Give up already! There's no point in running!
skills.description: Chin inflicts 2 layers of Poisonous Feathers on all enemies, dealing indirect damage equal to 1%/3%/6%/10%/15% of the targets' max HP based on how many stacks (1-5) they have (cannot exceed 280% of Chin's ATK). ; : ;Poisonous Feathers (毒の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Inflicts a Grade of Poison equal to the number of Poisonous Feathers they have, lasts for 2 turns. Deals indirect damage at the start of turn, then removes 1 stack. Max of 5 stacks.

upgrades.text: Indirect damage based on Poisonous Feathers' stacks increases to 1.5%/4.5%/9%/15%/22.5%.
When Chin deals indirect damage, each layer of Poison Feathers reduce the target's DEF by 50.
Indirect damage based on Poisonous Feathers' stacks increases to 2%/6%/12%/20%/30%.
When trying to inflict Poisonous Feathers on targets who already have max stacks, deals indirect damage equal to 30% of their max HP (cannot exceed 280% of Chin's ATK).

skills.name: Poison Erosion (毒蚀/毒素爆発)
skills.line: How does it feel to be poisoned?
skills.description: Chin releases the toxins in her feathers to attack 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 175% of her ATK. For enemies with Poisonous Feathers stacks, consumes all their stacks to deal indirect damage equal to 35% of her ATK for each stack. ;Poisonous Feathers (毒の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Inflicts a Grade of Poison equal to the number of Poisonous Feathers they have, lasts for 2 turns. Deals indirect damage at the start of turn, then removes 1 stack. Max of 5 stacks.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 193% and indirect damage increases to 39%.
Damage increases to 210% and indirect damage increases to 42%.
When using this skill, immediately inflict 3 stacks of Poisonous Feathers on the enemy.
If the enemy is not KO'd, immediately uses Poisonous Beauty on them.

bio.condition: With Chin clear any zone 40 times.
